positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Focusing on modernizing the legacy test infrastructure for Windows OS and devices. This includes optimizing test execution and infrastructure as well as designing and implementing new features for devices and features in current development. 

Along with my engineering work, I encourage and engage my team in discussions and education about inclusivity in the workplace.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Working within the Engineering Systems of Microsoft to create tools to test enterprise OS
- Currently focusing on enabling dynamic virtual machine allocation for large OS testing in an effort to move more testing devices to the cloud
- Drove security effort for the team to digram testing services and ecosystems and collaborated in identifying potential threats

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Created and implemented a telemetry gathering class to collect real-time data for an internal testing tool
Collaborated with team members to ensure that data collected was meaningful 
Designed and developed a dashboard for telemetry data to reflect reliability of the tool

volunteerExperiences.description:
Led and supported backpacking trips of eight first-years for five days

Completed trail crew work to improve pieces of the Vermont Trail for future use

Walked and trained shelter dogs for basic manners and tricks to prepare them for adoption

Noted dog behavior to assist adopter pairing for better forever home placements

projects.title: StreetSpot
projects.description: StreetSpot works to help students find housing off-campus. Students may rate their living experiences, including their landlords, and find housing near their university. Although not yet live, it is in the works post Tufts Polyhack.

projects.title: Greater Boston Legal Services Affidavit Web Application with JumboCode
projects.description: Designed and wrote a web-based application to aid undocumented immigrants who are victims of certain crimes record as they record answers to write an affidavit.
